headline: Ex-MP Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman arrested over airport assault and disorder
summary: The Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former lawmaker was detained by the Detective Branch following allegations of harassing an airport official.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman, a Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former Member of Parliament.
caption:
A former lawmaker and Jamaat leader has been arrested following an alleged assault at the airport.

The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested Major (retd) Akhtaruzzaman, a Jamaat-e-Islami leader and former Member of Parliament.

headline_marked: bdnews24.com [[Editor Toufique Imrose Khalidi passes away]] at 59
headline: bdnews24.com Editor Toufique Imrose Khalidi passes away at 59
summary: The veteran journalist and publisher died while receiving treatment at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London on Friday.
details: Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the Editor-in-Chief and Publisher of bdnews24.com, has passed away at the age of 59.
He died on Friday, October 2, while undergoing treatment at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London.
Reports indicate that he suffered a sudden dizzy spell and collapsed at his hotel yesterday, after which hotel authorities rushed him to the hospital.
Medical professionals declared him dead upon arrival or during treatment at the facility.
Khalidi had been serving as the publisher and editor-in-chief of bdnews24.com since 2006, establishing himself as a pioneer in digital journalism in Bangladesh.
The President of Bangladesh and the State Minister have expressed their condolences, hailing his significant contributions to journalism and describing him as a pioneer of the field.
caption:
A pioneer of digital journalism in Bangladesh has passed away. Toufique Imrose Khalidi, Editor-in-Chief of bdnews24.com, died at 59.

Toufique Imrose Khalidi, the Editor-in-Chief and Publisher of bdnews24.com, has passed away at the age of 59.

He died on Friday, October 2, while undergoing treatment at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London.

Reports indicate that he suffered a sudden dizzy spell and collapsed at his hotel yesterday, after which hotel authorities rushed him to the hospital.

Medical professionals declared him dead upon arrival or during treatment at the facility.

Khalidi had been serving as the publisher and editor-in-chief of bdnews24.com since 2006, establishing himself as a pioneer in digital journalism in Bangladesh.

The President of Bangladesh and the State Minister have expressed their condolences, hailing his significant contributions to journalism and describing him as a pioneer of the field.

#Bangladesh #Journalism #bdnews24 #ToufiqueImroseKhalidi #News

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Prothom Alo
